## accepted: NONE | G:<genre> (genre only) | S:<style> (that style under every tree parent) | P:<genre>/<style>; ' | ' separates acceptable answers.
## Rules: R1 tag names a Discogs genre -> genre only (plus a same-named style). R2 tag names or spells a Discogs style (typo, spacing, synonym, translation) -> that style.
##   R3 tag is a sub-variant of a Discogs style (e.g. 'melodic black metal') -> the parent style(s). R4 genre-like but no Discogs style fits -> genre only plus the closest styles.

##   R5 not a genre (place, nationality, year/decade, person/band/work, label, instrument, voice, mood, opinion, format, personal) -> NONE. Artist and composer names stay NONE even when they imply a genre.
##   R6 reads both as a non-genre and as a genre -> NONE plus the genre reading(s).
## Bias: the flat-Claude baseline is graded against a key drafted by a Claude model; treat its score as optimistic until a person has reviewed this file.
## Review: change 'accepted' (and 'confidence' to 'reviewed') and fill 'reviewer'; unsure rows are first.
